```python
    trials = case['trials']

        ref = trial['reflection']

            cache[sig].update({'last_trial': i, 'reflection': ref, 'success': suc})
            cache.move_to_end(sig)

                oldest = next(iter(cache))
                del cache[oldest]
            cache[sig] = {'last_trial': i, 'reflection': ref, 'success': suc}

        memory.append({
            'last_trial': info['last_trial'],
            'reflection': info['reflection'],
            'signature': sig,
            'success': info['success']
        })
    signatures = list(cache.keys())
    return {'memory': memory, 'signatures': signatures}
```
